title: CLEAR: Context Augmentation from Contrastive Learning of Experience via Agentic Reflection
abstract: arXiv:2604.07487v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language model agents rely on effective model context to obtain task-relevant information for decision-making. Many existing context engineering approaches primarily rely on the context generated from the past experience and retrieval mechanisms that reuse these context. However, retrieved context from past tasks must be adapted by the execution agent to fit new situations, placing additional reasoning burden on the underlying LLM. To address this limitation, we propose a generative context augmentation framework using Contrastive Learning of Experience via Agentic Reflection (CLEAR). CLEAR first employs a reflection agent to perform contrastive analysis over past execution trajectories and summarize useful context for each observed task. translated_title: CLEAR：通过智能体反思的经验对比学习实现上下文增强
translated_abstract: 大语言模型智能体依赖有效的模型上下文来获取与任务相关的信息以进行决策。许多现有的上下文工程方法主要依赖于从过去经验中生成的上下文以及复用这些上下文的检索机制。然而，从过去任务中检索到的上下文必须由执行智能体加以调整才能适应新的情况，这给底层大语言模型带来了额外的推理负担。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了一种基于智能体反思的经验对比学习（CLEAR）的生成式上下文增强框架。CLEAR首先使用反思智能体对过去的执行轨迹进行对比分析，并为每个观察到的任务总结出有用的上下文。这些摘要随后被用作监督微调数据来训练一个上下文增强模型（CAM）。接着，我们进一步使用强化学习对CAM进行优化，其中奖励信号是……
tldr: 提出CLEAR生成式上下文增强框架，通过反思智能体对历史执行轨迹进行对比学习并以监督微调和强化学习训练上下文增强模型，从而生成适配新任务的上下文、减轻执行智能体复用历史经验时的推理负担。
en_tdlr: CLEAR is a generative context augmentation framework that uses agentic reflection to contrastively analyze past execution trajectories, then trains a context augmentation model via supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning to produce task-adapted context, reducing the reasoning burden of reusing retrieved experience in LLM agents.
